rows.gloss_en: forced or compelled to do something
rows.example_en: With no wind in our favour, we were obliged to wait at anchor for days
rows.example_cn: 由于没有顺风,我们只得抛锚等候了好几天

rows.gloss_cn: 心境、性情、秉性;(动)调和、揉和(黏土)
rows.gloss_en: one's state of mind or natural disposition; to knead and work clay
rows.modern_en: a tendency to become angry easily
rows.example_en: Even in the worst storm his calm temper never once forsook him
rows.example_cn: 即便在最猛的风暴里,他那份沉静的心境也不曾离他而去

rows.gloss_cn: 提供、给予、提议;(offer to do)企图、试图
rows.gloss_en: to present or give something; (offer to do) to attempt or venture
rows.modern_en: to present something for someone to accept
rows.example_en: The frightened beast did not offer to fall upon the men on shore
rows.example_cn: 那受惊的野兽并没有试图去扑岸上的人

skipped: prevent(本书=免得/防止/妨碍,四处皆'阻止某事发生',同现代义)
sad(本书=悲伤/凄凉/忧愁,同现代义'难过的')
mean(核对25处:21处='I mean…'=意思是现代义,仅4处形容词'低微/粗劣';少数→按规则③不建行,整本覆盖成'低微'会误伤21处)
